title: Kingman 1953 crash: Arthur Stansel sees small being in tent
summary: UAPGerb tells of Kingman 1953 crash: Arthur Stansel sees small being in tent, about 1953 at Kingman, Arizona, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> it's like a makeshift tent that there's a tiny little brownish bean possibly charred and mangled cuz he was sent in to do uh ballistic trajectory analysis.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells on Jesse Michels's podcast of a reported crash of an unknown craft near Kingman, Arizona, in 1953. According to UAPGerb, a man named Arthur Stansel was sent to the site to work out the object's flight path, and inside a makeshift tent he saw a tiny brownish being, possibly charred and mangled. If true, it would mean a non-human body was recovered by the government.
